assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease and reports intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by dizziness and giddiness.
The service is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease.
The clinical indication is documented in the clinical indication note.
The service supports diagnosis code I25.10.
The service supports diagnosis code R00.2.
The service supports diagnosis code R42.
The patient has established coronary artery disease.
